newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia arrests man for killing, dismembering three.
newsitem.headline: Russia arrests man for killing, dismembering three.

text.p: Police in Russia's northwestern Karelia province have arrested a man accused of killing and dismembering his sister, her boyfriend and another man, Itar-Tass news agency said on Thursday.

The suspect, 38, confessed to murdering the three in a drunken row, it said. Police were tipped off when a tramp hunting for bottles in a rubbish bin in the regional capital Petrozavodsk came across a human hand, Tass quoted local police as saying.
The suspect said he had killed his sister, her partner and his friend, cut up the bodies, put the pieces in a child's pushchair and dumped them in the bins, the agency reported.
Police called to the scene of the tramp's discovery found a severed foot and plastic sacks containing other body parts of the three victims, it added.
The suspect later showed police where he had put the heads, Tass said.
